package.name: aus-topo-cenozoic
package.author: Christian Heine
package.notes: Reconstructed Australian topography for the Cenozoic (last 65 Million years). Data is in GMT [netCDF](http://www.unicar.edu/netcdf) format. Description of how models were constructed is available in [Heine et al., Tectonophysics, 2010](http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.tecto.2009.08.028). Grids are in 0.033 degrees resolution and in present-day coordinates.
package.title: Reconstructed Cenozoic Australian Topography
